harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with `blacklist usb-storage` and `install usb-storage /bin/false`, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the setting is active in early boot, verified the module cannot be loaded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed via a changed boot_id and fresh uptime that the blacklist persists and usb-storage remains blocked after reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected OS (RHEL 7.9, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64) and confirmed usb-storage was not loaded and no prior blacklist existed
Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist and install /bin/false directives
Rebuilt initramfs for the running kernel with dracut -f so the blacklist takes effect at early boot
Verified modprobe usb-storage fails and lsmod shows no usb_storage before reboot
Verified via lsinitrd that the new initramfs contains the blacklist config file
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime, then triggered `shutdown -r now` in background so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it became reachable again, confirming a new boot_id (proof of genuine restart)
Re-verified post-reboot that the blacklist config file still exists, usb-storage is not loaded, and modprobe still fails to load it

evidence.requirement: usb-storage not currently loaded / no pre-existing blacklist
evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL 7.9 kernel, usb_storage absent from lsmod, and no existing modprobe.d entries for usb-storage

evidence.requirement: Module blacklisted to prevent loading now and after reboot
evidence.summary: Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false) and rebuilt initramfs with dracut; lsinitrd confirms the config file is embedded in the new initramfs image
modprobe usb-storage exits 1 with 'Operation not permitted' and lsmod shows no usb_storage loaded

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 0d6209e2-350d-4cd9-8a7d-11f7c08072be and uptime -s baseline prior to restart

Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via nohup returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED immediately, then the node became unreachable on subsequent polls (cmd-6a03120f62d14d45, cmd-9c404e1cb727471c), confirming the reboot proceeded

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id 58ba3f94-cb0b-4f1b-93c7-ae6964938a7b differs from the pre-restart baseline, proving a genuine kernel restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Blacklist persists and usb-storage remains blocked after reboot
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: blacklist config file still present, lsmod shows no usb_storage, modprobe usb-storage still fails with Operation not permitted, and uptime -s shows a fresh 2026-09-29 10:28:29 boot time
